camel_example: aliyun alidns DescribeDomains --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-re00000000' --PageNumber 1 --KeyWord com --Lang en --Starmark true --SearchMode LIKE --GroupId defaultGroup
description_en: Queries the domain name list of the user based on the parameter query
description_zh: 根据传入参数查询该用户的域名列表
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-domains --lang en --key-word com --group-id defaultGroup --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --search-mode LIKE --resource-group-id rg-re00000000 --starmark true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomains

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
zh：中文
en：英文

默认：zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The keyword. The search is performed in the "%KeyWord%" format and is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 关键字，按照“%KeyWord%”模式搜索，不区分大小写
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the domain name group.

If you do not specify this parameter or specify an empty string, the query is performed under All Domains.

If you specify defaultGroup, the query is performed under Default Group
parameters.help_zh:
指域名分组ID。

如不填或传空字符，将在全部域名下查询。

如传defaultGroup，将在默认分组下查询
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The Settings for the number of entries per page for paging in a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The search mode. Valid values:

LIKE: fuzzy search.
EXACT: exact search.

Default value: LIKE
parameters.help_zh:
搜索模式。取值：

LIKE：模糊搜索
EXACT：精确搜索

默认：LIKE
parameters.name: search_mode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query starred domain names. Valid values:

true: yes.

false: no.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询域名星标。取值：

true：是

false：否

默认：true
parameters.name: starmark
